scope_reason: These exact test, generated-admission, training-tool, and historical research files contain the 42 registered HLT-033 sites and file-level findings recorded below. The H155 executor loads only H153 Git blobs at a fixed commit after SHA-256 checks; H154/H158/H159/H161/H164/H168/H173 runners load the manifest-pinned H50 fused input and SHA-verified fixed-commit guard only after input and executor verification. The exact executor hashes for these files remain in their manifests. The file-scoped auditor skip is coarse, so CI re-audits every whole file and requires exact source SHA-256 plus exact rule/fingerprint inventory; a changed-scope repository audit verifies all raw findings and copy-code classes touching registered paths. Any byte drift, missing finding, or new finding fails closed. Current raw copy-code identities were re-reviewed against the complete Jankurai 1.7.6 --include-tests copy-code scan at captured source d985ab3975f5ce1d2c4c7d89271e45c313d5a7d4; all 34 currently emitted classes involving the exact registered paths are retained. On 2026-11-05, the same 34-class inventory was re-reviewed against the complete retained Jankurai 1.7.6 --include-tests copy-code scan for source a1e47407f30b32665f8d970d9553ea8f1e332502 (CI run 41942757274, job 126967394843; artifact SHA-256 9990949a63f7717062cb5b23d1e836be1179a46ec158e8118fe665f073620151). Exactly four raw identities were refreshed to include six additional instances across five visualization files: SHA-256 helper bodies in short_recipe_source.py, neural_cell_influence.py, code_pages.py and select_examples.py, and the empty Busy exception class in orchestration/render_uhd.py. The 30 other identities, registered paths and source hashes, rule dispositions, severities, policy exclusions and expiry are unchanged; no new audit exclusion or waiver is introduced.
